controls.name: Account Management
controls.remediation: Remove unused accounts. Restrict OpenClaw allowlist to named users only.

controls.name: Access Enforcement
controls.remediation: Set workspaceOnly=true. Set sandbox mode to all. Restrict sudoers. Disable browser noSandbox. Set hooks.allowRequestSessionKey=false.

controls.name: Least Privilege
controls.remediation: Disable elevated exec unless required. Confirm service account has no unnecessary group memberships. Set agents.defaults.subagents.allowChildOverrides=false. Disable gateway terminal.

controls.name: Remote Access
controls.remediation: Set gateway.bind to loopback. Enable gateway.auth.mode=token. Set auth rateLimit. Disable external hooks and gateway terminal.

controls.name: Event Logging
controls.remediation: Enable auditd. Set OpenClaw logging level to info or higher.

controls.name: Content of Audit Records
controls.remediation: Ensure audit records include timestamp, user, action, and outcome.

controls.name: Protection of Audit Information
controls.remediation: Audit logs must be owned by root, mode 600. Restrict write access.

controls.name: Audit Record Generation
controls.remediation: Add auditd watch rules for ~/.openclaw/secrets/ and OpenClaw config files. Review transcripts.autoStart sources.

controls.name: Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.remediation: Review security.audit.suppressions entries. Every suppression must be justified and periodically reviewed. Unreviewed suppressions create blind spots.

controls.name: Baseline Configuration
controls.remediation: Maintain openclaw.json.baseline as the documented configuration baseline.

controls.name: Configuration Settings
controls.remediation: Apply all settings in openclaw.json.baseline. Apply all Sarge hardening scripts. Verify models.mode, session.dmScope, and cron settings match baseline.

controls.name: Least Functionality
controls.remediation: Disable unused OpenClaw plugins, skills, and tools. Set skills.workshop.approvalPolicy=review. Disable browser unless needed. Set discovery.mdns.mode=minimal. Remove unnecessary OS packages.

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Org Users)
controls.remediation: Enable PAM faillock. Restrict OpenClaw to authenticated Discord/channel users only.

controls.name: Authenticator Management
controls.remediation: Set pwquality minlen=12, complexity rules. Set PASS_MAX_DAYS=90, PASS_MIN_DAYS=1.

controls.name: Authentication Feedback
controls.remediation: Ensure login failure messages do not reveal whether username or password was wrong.

controls.name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.remediation: Enable TLS on gateway. Use Cloudflare Tunnel (TLS enforced) for all remote access.

controls.name: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.remediation: Secrets directory must be 700. All secret files must be 600. Owner must be service account only.

controls.name: Flaw Remediation
controls.remediation: Enable unattended-upgrades for security patches. Review and apply pending updates.

controls.name: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.remediation: Set session.dmScope to per-channel-peer. Review tools.web settings. Disable diagnostics.otel.captureContent unless the collector is within your data boundary.

controls.name: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.remediation: Configure gateway.auth.rateLimit with maxAttempts=10, windowMs=60000, lockoutMs=300000. Configure PAM faillock.

controls.name: Session Termination
controls.remediation: Set mcp.sessionIdleTtlMs to 600000 (10 min). Set subagents.archiveAfterMinutes to 60. Review cron.sessionRetention.

controls.name: Configuration Change Control
controls.remediation: Set gateway.reload.mode to hybrid. Disable update.auto unless stableDelayHours >= 6. Review restart command availability.

controls.name: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.remediation: Set skills.workshop.approvalPolicy to review. Disable allowUploadedArchives and allowSymlinkTargetWrites. Review plugin entries for hooks.allowPromptInjection.

controls.name: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.remediation: Set per-model rate limits. Bound maxConcurrent to 4 for agents, 8 for subagents. Set cron.maxConcurrentRuns to 8.

controls.name: Boundary Protection
controls.remediation: Set browser.ssrfPolicy.dangerouslyAllowPrivateNetwork=false. Set discovery.mdns.mode=minimal. Disable external hooks unless required.

controls.name: Information System Monitoring
controls.remediation: Enable diagnostics, audit, and cron.failureAlert. Enable auditd on the host. Review security.audit.suppressions for blind spots.

controls.name: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.remediation: If rescue mode is enabled, restrict to ownerDmOnly=true. Set pendingTtlMinutes to a short window (5 min default) to prevent stale rescue state.

controls.name: Continuous Monitoring
controls.remediation: Enable security.installPolicy. Review audit suppressions. Enable diagnostics.

controls.name: Fail-Safe Procedures
controls.remediation: Bound cron retry.maxAttempts. If crestodian rescue is enabled, set short pendingTtlMinutes.

controls.name: Information Management and Retention
controls.remediation: Set compaction.mode to safeguard. Enable memoryFlush and truncateAfterCompaction. Review transcripts.maxUtterances and media.ttlHours retention bounds. Review compaction thresholds on CM-2 baseline cadence.

controls.name: Malicious Code Protection
controls.remediation: Install and configure ClamAV or equivalent. Schedule regular scans.

controls.name: Audit Log Storage Capacity
controls.remediation: Ensure the audit log partition retains at least 10% free space. Configure log rotation with adequate headroom or expand storage.

controls.name: Response to Audit Processing Failures
controls.remediation: Set disk_full_action and admin_space_left_action in auditd.conf to something other than IGNORE (e.g. SYSLOG, EMAIL, HALT).

controls.name: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
controls.remediation: Install auditd (provides ausearch) or configure rsyslog forwarding so audit records can be queried and aggregated.

controls.name: Time Stamps
controls.remediation: Enable NTP synchronization: sudo timedatectl set-ntp true.

controls.name: Audit Record Retention
controls.remediation: Configure logrotate for audit logs with a 'rotate' count of at least 4 (weekly rotation) to meet minimum retention.

controls.name: Internal System Connections
controls.remediation: Document each MCP server connection in the system security plan / interconnection agreements. Remove any unused or unauthorized servers.

controls.name: System Backup
controls.remediation: Configure a scheduled backup (cron or systemd timer) of ~/.openclaw config, secrets, and workspace state. Verify backups are recoverable.

controls.name: Identifier Management
controls.remediation: Eliminate duplicate UIDs in /etc/passwd. Never reuse a UID after deleting an account.

controls.name: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.remediation: Disable SSHv1 and weak ciphers (3DES, RC4/arcfour, CBC-mode) in sshd_config. Set gateway TLS minVersion to TLSv1.2 or higher.

controls.name: Identification and Authentication (Non-Org Users)
controls.remediation: Set an explicit auth.mode and register auth.providers. Disable anonymous access so external channel users (Discord/Telegram/etc.) are identified before gateway trust.

controls.name: Re-authentication
controls.remediation: Set mcp.sessionIdleTtlMs to a finite, reasonable value (e.g. 24h or less) so idle sessions require re-authentication.

controls.name: Application Partitioning
controls.remediation: Run OpenClaw under a dedicated non-root service account. Consider container or namespace isolation.

controls.name: Information in Shared Resources
controls.remediation: Configure periodic cleanup of /tmp session data. Review /dev/shm for sensitive residue.

controls.name: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.remediation: All key/credential files must be 600 or 400. SSH private keys must be 600.

controls.name: Cryptographic Protection
controls.remediation: Use OpenSSL 1.1+ or 3.x for FIPS capability. Node.js 18+ enforces TLS 1.2+ by default.

controls.name: Collaborative Computing Devices
controls.remediation: Disable camera/microphone capabilities in openclaw.json unless required. Remove /dev/video* access for the agent user.

controls.name: Session Authenticity
controls.remediation: Set auth.enabled: true and configure a strong gatewayToken in openclaw.json.

controls.name: Process Isolation
controls.remediation: Run OpenClaw in a container or systemd slice with resource limits. Use network and PID namespaces to isolate the agent.

controls.name: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.remediation: Ensure APT::Get::AllowUnauthenticated is unset or false. Verify apt repository GPG keys are configured under /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/.

controls.name: Memory Protection
controls.remediation: Set kernel.randomize_va_space=2 for full ASLR: sudo sysctl -w kernel.randomize_va_space=2.

controls.name: External System Services
controls.remediation: Review each configured mcp.servers entry for a data-sharing agreement and supply-chain risk assessment. Remove servers that are no longer needed.

controls.name: Unsupported System Components
controls.remediation: Upgrade Ubuntu and Node.js before their end-of-life dates. Track EOL schedules at https://endoflife.date/ubuntu and https://endoflife.date/nodejs.

controls.name: Media Sanitization
controls.remediation: Set media.ttlHours to a positive retention window and media.maxSizeMb to bound stored media size in the OpenClaw config.

controls.name: Component Authenticity
controls.remediation: Add source/author/origin metadata to installed skills. Verify APT package signing keys are present under /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/.

controls.name: Separation of Duties
controls.remediation: Run OpenClaw under a dedicated service account that is not a member of the sudo/admin group.

controls.name: System Use Notification
controls.remediation: Set a Banner directive in sshd_config pointing to a system-use notification file.

controls.name: Concurrent Session Control
controls.remediation: Set a maxlogins limit in /etc/security/limits.conf to bound concurrent sessions per user.

controls.name: Device Lock
controls.remediation: Set TMOUT in /etc/profile or /etc/profile.d/ to auto-lock idle shell sessions.

controls.name: Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
controls.remediation: Set auth.enabled to true in openclaw.json so gateway actions require identification/authentication.

controls.name: System Component Inventory
controls.remediation: Maintain an approved component list and reconcile it against the reported Node.js version, MCP servers, and plugins.

controls.name: User-Installed Software
controls.remediation: Review globally-installed npm packages and remove any that are not approved for the host.

controls.name: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.remediation: Install a vulnerability scanner (trivy or grype recommended). Run npm audit on OpenClaw dependencies. Apply pending OS security patches.
